body: The Lobby Tiki Bar keeps the week moving. Every Tuesday is Tiki Taco Tuesday — 30% off all rum drinks from open to close, paired with island-inspired tacos. Monday through Friday we run happy hour with discounted cocktails, beer, wine, and bites.
Inside The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way, steps from the Oceanside Pier. The kind of weekly ritual a neighborhood bar is supposed to provide.

privateEvents.body: Book The Lobby for your next birthday, corporate event, bar buyout, or rehearsal dinner. Full bar program, island-inspired food, tiki atmosphere.
